title: How to deepen existing relationships
content: Relationships deepen through gradually increasing openness, sharing something a bit more personal and having it received well, then a bit more next time. It also helps to actively show up: remembering details, following up on things they mentioned, and being the one to initiate sometimes rather than always waiting to be invited.
